name: Mosaic ImmunoEngineering Inc.
summary: Mosaic ImmunoEngineering Inc. is an early-stage biotechnology firm dedicated to the advancement and commercialization of an immunomodulatory platform technology. This innovative platform aims to provide therapeutic solutions for cancer and infectious diseases in both human and animal health. The company's core product is MIE-101, a nanoparticle-based treatment sourced from the cowpea mosaic virus, which has demonstrated non-infectious characteristics in mice, dogs, and humans. Headquartered in Novato, California, the company commenced operations in 2020.
